capitalPath.zhCn: 以化名发布 Bitcoin 白皮书和开源客户端
capitalPath.en: Published the Bitcoin paper and open-source client under a pseudonym

capitalPath.zhCn: 在网络早期低竞争阶段参与挖矿，可能积累大量未移动 BTC
capitalPath.en: Mined during the low-competition launch period and may have accumulated substantial unmoved BTC

capitalPath.zhCn: 2010至2011年退出公开开发；没有可核验的套现路径
capitalPath.en: Withdrew from public development in 2010–2011; no verifiable monetization path is known

finding.zhCn: 聚类模型只能推测，不能全部归属于中本聪
finding.en: Clustering models are inferential and cannot attribute every early address to Satoshi

finding.zhCn: 不存在可由创始人单方面支配的公司或国库
finding.en: No founder-controlled company or treasury can unilaterally govern the network

finding.zhCn: 身份、继承人、税务和密钥控制均未知
finding.en: Identity, heirs, tax position, and key control remain unknown

finding.zhCn: 白皮书、代码和早期通信共同确认
finding.en: Confirmed by the paper, code, and early correspondence

finding.zhCn: 来自地址聚类模型，不是已确认余额
finding.en: Derived from clustering models, not a confirmed balance

claim.zhCn: 某位候选人就是中本聪

finding.zhCn: 没有候选人完成公钥签名等决定性证明
finding.en: No candidate has supplied decisive proof such as a valid signature from known keys

openQuestions.zhCn: 谁能用已知早期密钥完成签名证明？
openQuestions.en: Who can sign a fresh message with a recognized early key?

openQuestions.zhCn: 哪些早期区块可以通过更透明、可复现的方法归入同一矿工？
openQuestions.en: Which early blocks can reproducibly be attributed to one miner?

summary.zhCn: 加入统一资本路径、资产边界和身份主张证据表。
summary.en: Added standardized capital path, asset boundaries, and identity-claim evidence.
